headline: Curated genomic resources add structure-aware orthology, AI-assisted curation and annotation quality metrics
label: Biological Database Infrastructure
summary: New releases of OMA, VEuPathDB and the IGVF portal pair expanded content with infrastructure and AI-oriented changes, alongside annotation-quality and graph tools.
synthesis: The common thread is maintenance and scaling of public genomic resources. OMA 2027 covers 2983 extant and 1226 ancestral genomes and adds structure-aware orthology (3Di, structural alignments), FastOMA, OrthoXML tools and a chromosome viewer. VEuPathDB 2026 reports 2,602 datasets for eukaryotic pathogens, vectors and hosts, with OrthoMCL, AI-assisted curation and a PostgreSQL migration. The IGVF Data Portal offers a repository and API for consortium data, with knowledge-graph integration and agentic-tool access. New elements are structural information in orthology inference and AI-assisted curation or access layers. ABAQS, which scores annotation completeness, gene model validity and protein profile accuracy, and PanAbyss, for querying pangenome graphs, address annotation quality and graph exploration. vartracker, a longitudinal pathogen variant tool, lies at the edge of the thread.
